snippet.title: The Velvet Green Witch : A Quiet Life PV
snippet.description:
steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4578960/

About This Game

The Velvet Green Witch: A Quiet Life is a slow-paced survival RPG about living alongside a solitary witch in a remote forest.

After losing your place in the world, you find refuge in an abandoned treatment facility deep in the woods—where a witch already resides.
What begins as an uneasy encounter gradually turns into a quiet, shared life.

Spend your days exploring the forest, gathering resources, and crafting useful items through alchemy.
As time passes, your bond deepens through small conversations and shared routines.

But beneath this peaceful life, something is stirring.

A strange miasma spreads through the forest, turning plants and creatures hostile.
Every few days, the threat grows stronger.

You are not heroes.
Just two people trying to live quietly—while facing something you cannot ignore.
